No filters · f picker · 1 todo  2 doing  3 done  4 blocked
NAVIGATION AND FIND                                     EDIT · every action requires confirmation
j/k ↑/↓         move / scroll                                           [ / ]       previous / next acceptance or dependency in detail
< / gg / Home   top                                                     Space       toggle acceptance (default first)
> / G / End     bottom                                                  Tab + Enter focus dependencies and follow selected task
ctrl-d / ctrl-u half page down / up                                     t / d / x   take / done / drop task
PgDn / PgUp     full page down / up                                     J / K       move down / up in global rank order
h/← Shift-Tab   previous pane / column                                  n           new title, goal and one verification item
l/→ Tab         next pane / column                                      e           edit in $EDITOR, then refresh + lint
Enter           open full task detail                                   Enter / Esc confirm / cancel every editing action
Esc             back one level, never quits
q / ctrl-c      quit (q only outside inputs)
/               live find; Enter keeps, Esc clears
:               palette with command + value completion
Tab / Enter     complete palette choice; Enter runs complete command
ctrl-n/p / ↑↓   select palette completion
?               help overlay, including from inputs
#               jump by id prefix / TASK-number alias
f               filter picker: s/t/p/g/l/o
1 / 2 / 3 / 4   filter todo / doing / done / blocked
Backspace / F   remove last chip / clear all filters
o / i / b / !   views: overview / list (also v) / board / lint
s / y           status / type palette shortcut
c               clear all filters
r               refresh files and lint

PALETTE: overview, list, board, todo, doing, done, blocked, dropped, status <s>, type <t>, priority <p>, group <g>, label <l>, owner <o>,
goto <id>, lint, clear, help
Filter fields: s status, t type, p priority, g group, l label, o owner. Blocked is derived from unmet dependencies and overlaps todo/doing.
Filters combine.
